verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud platform that ships a CLI, MCP server and SDKs, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of any opt-out for Render's own telemetry or usage tracking. The only telemetry mention (render-docs-13) is about streaming customers' infrastructure metrics to external tools, which is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
